zh: 要是我有更多时间，我就会去学吉他。（可惜我没时间）
en: If I {had} more time, I {would learn} the guitar.

zh: 如果我是你，我会接受那份工作。
en: If I {were|was} you, I {would take|would accept} the job.

zh: 我真希望我会开车。（可惜我不会）
en: I wish I {knew} how to drive.

zh: 我真希望昨晚没吃那么多。
en: I wish I {hadn't eaten|had not eaten} so much last night.

zh: 要是我们当时早点出发，就赶上那班渡轮了。
en: If we {had left} earlier, we {would have caught|could have caught} the ferry.

zh: 已经很晚了，我们该走了。
en: It's getting late. It's time we {left|went}.

zh: 我宁愿你别在屋里抽烟。
en: I'd rather you {didn't smoke|did not smoke} in the house.

zh: 我建议他休几天假。
en: I suggest he {take|takes|should take} a few days off.

zh: 你本应该早点告诉我的。
en: You {should have told|ought to have told} me earlier.

zh: 要是我中了彩票，我会在海边买一栋房子。
en: If I {won} Lotto, I {would buy} a house by the beach.

zh: 要是我的英语再好一点就好了。
en: If only my English {were|was} better.

zh: 要是她昨天备份了数据库，我们就不会丢数据了。
en: If she {had backed up} the database yesterday, we {wouldn't have lost|would not have lost} any data.

zh: 我真希望我住得离公司近一点。
en: I wish I {lived} closer to the office.

zh: 医生建议她少吃盐。
en: The doctor recommended that she {eat|should eat} less salt.

zh: 他坚持要我们留下来吃晚饭。
en: He insisted that we {stay|should stay} for dinner.

zh: 要不是现在雨下得这么大，我们就去跑步了。
en: If it {weren't|wasn't|were not|was not} raining so hard, we {would go} for a run.

zh: 我本来可以帮你的，你当时怎么不说呢？
en: I {could have helped} you. Why didn't you ask?

zh: 我要是今天早上带了伞就好了。
en: I wish I {had brought|had taken} an umbrella this morning.

zh: 要是我有车，我就开车送你去机场。（可惜我没有车）
en: If I {had} a car, I {would drive} you to the airport.

zh: 你早该学会自己做饭了。
en: It's high time you {learned|learnt} to cook for yourself.

zh: 我宁愿你明天来，而不是今天来。
en: I'd rather you {came} tomorrow instead of today.

zh: 要是我当时知道你在住院，我就去看你了。
en: If I {had known} you were in hospital, I {would have visited} you.

zh: 假如你丢了工作，你会怎么办？
en: What would you do if you {lost} your job?

zh: 我真不该买这双鞋，太紧了。
en: I {shouldn't have bought|should not have bought} these shoes. They're too tight.

zh: 要是我去年接受了那份工作，我现在就住在惠灵顿了。
en: If I {had taken} that job last year, I {would be} living in Wellington now.

zh: 我真希望今天不用上班。
en: I wish I {didn't have|did not have} to work today.

zh: 如果我是老板，我会让大家周五在家办公。
en: If I {were|was} the boss, I {would let} everyone work from home on Fridays.

zh: 经理要求每个人都准时到。
en: The manager demanded that everyone {be|should be} on time.

zh: 要是你昨晚没熬那么晚，今天早上就不会迟到了。
en: If you {hadn't stayed|had not stayed} up so late, you {wouldn't have been|would not have been} late this morning.

zh: 昨晚的聚会很棒，真希望你当时也在。
en: It was a great party last night. I wish you {had been} there.

zh: 要是我当时没说那句话就好了。
en: If only I {hadn't said|had not said} that.

zh: 没有你的帮助，我当时不可能按时完成。
en: I {couldn't have finished|could not have finished} on time without your help.

zh: 他要是多练习，会打得好得多，可他从来不练。
en: He {would play} much better if he {practised|practiced} more, but he never does.

zh: 我宁愿你当时没把惊喜的事告诉她。
en: I'd rather you {hadn't told|had not told} her about the surprise.

zh: 假如你能住在世界上任何地方，你会住在哪里？
en: If you {could} live anywhere in the world, where would you live?

zh: 你本来会很喜欢那部电影的，可惜你没能来。
en: You {would have loved|would have enjoyed} the film. It's a pity you couldn't come.

zh: 我提议把会议推迟到下周。
en: I propose that the meeting {be|should be} postponed until next week.

zh: 我真希望我们有个大一点的厨房。
en: I wish we {had} a bigger kitchen.

zh: 要是银行当初没借钱给我们，我们就不可能买下这栋房子。
en: We {couldn't have bought|could not have bought} this house if the bank {hadn't lent|had not lent} us the money.

zh: 孩子们该上床睡觉了。
en: It's time the kids {went} to bed.
